title: CIA document mandating 'shaping the emerging UAP narrative'

tellings.quote: I was exposed to a CIA document that gave the mandate. The mandate was to shape the emerging UAP narrative,

plain: A document from the CIA, the US spy agency, set out a mandate to "shape the emerging UAP narrative", UAP being the government's newer name for UFOs, according to Jeremy Corbell, a filmmaker who reports on the subject. Corbell says he was shown this document himself, and he names the journalist George Knapp and the Navy pilot David Fravor in telling it. No date is given, but if true it would mean the agency set out on purpose to steer how the public came to understand UFOs.
